capabilities: reveal whitelisted dot-folders in the native file explorer
index injected folders for search, graph, and metadata cache
add or remove revealed folders from plugin settings
rescan hidden folders via a command
reject paths with .. segments or absolute paths
extras: README warns that revealed folders become ordinary vault files readable by all plugins, including sync plugins that could upload secrets; recommends never revealing .env, .git, or token folders. Desktop only, and it relies on undocumented Obsidian internals with a load-time check that keeps it inactive if those methods disappear. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Revealing everything is dangerous because pointing Obsidian at a large folder like .git can freeze the app, so the author chose per-folder opt-in instead.
problem: Obsidian filters out every path starting with . at the vault-adapter level, so dot-folders never appear in the file explorer, search, or graph.
summary: Injects whitelisted dot-folders such as .claude or .github into the vault cache so they appear in the native file explorer, search, and graph.
